name: Vegas Cubing Cup Winter 2025

venue.name: The Orleans Hotel & Casino
venue.address: 4500 W Tropicana Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89103

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VegasCubingCupWinter2025#43190-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is sponsored by [SpeedCubeShop](http://speedcubeshop.com) and [West Coast Cubing](http://westcoastcubing.com)
